data.body: AC-7 addendum: the follow-up review-plan for 825c-ba3e-587b-4b7f returned INDETERMINATE/ticket-not-claimable because that ticket is now CLOSED — its owner completed it while this fix was in review, which also explains the description growth (4935 -> 7995 chars) that sign-review correctly named as terminal drift. A closed ticket needs no plan-review attestation, so no recovery is pending: 111a-4626-8d2c-42bf and 7931-faee-53ba-47b1 recovered via sign-review (signed, no LLM re-run, head 1a2b59ea91), and 825c is terminally closed. AC-7 satisfied.
